focus_policy.selection_reason: Cycle-three pivot review: explicit SAT representation cost and independent higher-rank arithmetic comparison. Not a ranking of solution probability.
focus_policy.reserve: NS and RH narrow routes paused per cycle3-review.json; all canonical obligations remain open.

tracks.attack: Define an operator from arithmetic data without using zeta zero locations; prove a domain/self-adjointness lemma and derive a complete determinant identity for the completed xi function.
tracks.falsify: Check deficiency indices, compactness/trace class or regularized determinant hypotheses, zero multiplicities and possible extra zeros. Use Lagarias/Li/Weil as a comparator; reject an assumed RH or a finite spectrum extrapolation.
tracks.exit: An unconditional operator construction plus identity and a logically checked implication for every nontrivial zero.

tracks.attack: Specify a deterministic SAT state representation and update rules, with an explicit invariant guaranteeing exact satisfiability preservation; derive a polynomial total encoding-size and bit-operation bound for arbitrary CNF.
tracks.falsify: Attack adversarial width-three Tseitin, pigeonhole and compression instances; track expansion, bit growth, branching and uniformity. Audit relativization, natural proofs (where applicable), and algebrization. Restricted lower bounds do not settle separation.
tracks.exit: Correctness and polynomial worst-case bit complexity on all encoded SAT inputs, or a separate registered unconditional separation argument.

tracks.attack: On the periodic unforced route, derive a scale-critical estimate for the actual nonlinear vorticity/velocity interaction that controls the L4_t L6_x norm up to every finite potential breakdown time for arbitrary admissible data.
tracks.falsify: Test scaling, concentration, high-low interactions and vortex stretching; reject energy-only control, constants depending on the unknown critical norm, or bounds stopping before the possible breakdown. Independently audit any announced forced-breakdown route under its own official hypotheses.
tracks.exit: An a priori estimate under the full periodic hypotheses and a justified continuation implication, or a distinct complete official breakdown alternative.

tracks.attack: Choose a specified four-dimensional non-Abelian lattice gauge action, initially SU(2), and seek a physical-unit correlation bound with constants uniform in volume and spacing along a justified renormalization trajectory; separately develop a nontrivial continuum limit and reconstruction.
tracks.falsify: Check gauge invariance, reflection positivity, regulator removal, observable overlap, tightness and nontriviality. Reject a lattice-unit gap or two-state model as physical mass-gap evidence.
tracks.exit: A nontrivial continuum theory satisfying required axioms and positive physical spectral gap for every required compact simple gauge group; SU(2) alone is a scoped milestone.

tracks.attack: Pick a precise smooth projective family beyond divisor-generated cohomology; compute the rational Hodge subspace and isolate a primitive class not accounted for by known cycle generators; attempt an actual algebraic correspondence or cycle construction.
tracks.falsify: Audit rationality, Hodge type, smooth projectivity, cycle-class map and primitive reduction. Distinguish a gap in a chosen generator span from a nonalgebraic class.
tracks.exit: Proved algebraic representatives for the remaining rational Hodge classes and a valid reduction covering all varieties/codimensions, or a valid counterexample.

tracks.attack: Choose a rank-at-least-two family over Q with rigorously sourced analytic order and descent/Selmer data; isolate the exact missing comparison map or bound and attempt a theorem beyond known rank-zero/one cases.
tracks.falsify: Audit analytic-order certificates, Mordell-Weil rank versus Selmer rank, local conditions, Sha finiteness, regulator, periods and Tamagawa factors. Do not use BSD to compute the evidence intended to prove BSD.
tracks.exit: Universal analytic/algebraic rank equality; for the refined route also Sha finiteness and normalized leading-term identity.

tracks.attack: Reconstruct the externally established proof one theorem at a time, starting with coherent transport of the nontrivial sweepout class and the precise surgery comparison-map hypotheses.
tracks.falsify: Check original Perelman and Kleiner-Lott/Colding-Minicozzi statements, local finiteness of surgeries, class transport, extinction and topological classification. A scalar inequality is not geometric reconstruction.
tracks.exit: Complete independently reviewed proof-dependency chain. Already solved externally; not a new prize target.
